Alex: Quick check — I'm about to open a Terraform PR that adds a Helm overlay + namespace affinity for ExternalSecrets so we don't accidentally shadow service account secrets during rotation. Can owners weigh in on the approach?
Maria: Thanks — can you paste the TF snippet? want to see the annotation shape and owner tags.
Alex: pasted below — testing locally against staging, plan looks clean.
```
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "payments_extsecret" {
  manifest = {
    apiVersion = "external-secrets.io/v1beta1"
    kind       = "ExternalSecret"
    metadata = {
      name      = "payments-credentials"
      namespace = var.namespace
      annotations = {
        "externalsecrets.redwood.io/rotation-jitter" = "30s"
        "externalsecrets.redwood.io/owner" = "team-payments"
      }
    }
    spec = {
      refreshInterval = "1h"
      target = { template = { metadata = { annotations = { "redwood/secret-affinity" = "namespace" } } } }
    }
  }
}
```
Sam: A few notes — the controller in prod debounces refreshes, but jitter helps avoid thundering herd. 30s is fine but make sure you test with shorter interval in staging. Also add the `redwood/owner` label so automation can claim ownership.
Linh: FYI oncall saw a brief spike when we rolled the payments secret last month — pods with projected volumes briefly restarted in one AZ. If this is sensitive, consider rollout by AZ or use the `replaceOnSecretChange: false` pattern for consumers that can hot-reload.
Maria: Do we need a preflight to detect secrets that are referenced by projected volumes vs env? I can add a small `kubectl` check in the pipeline. e.g. `kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath=\"{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.spec.volumes[*].projected}\"` — rough idea.
Alex: Good call. I'll add a `preflight.sh` that fails the TF apply if any target namespace has >0 projected-volume consumers for the secret unless `allow_replace=true`.
Maria: Also update the Helm overlay values so the `externalsecrets` chart renders the annotation for `rotation-jitter` and `owner`. Otherwise the overlay will override them.
Sam: One more: add a small `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan` check to CI and a smoke test that reads a secret via our internal test app. That will catch RBAC issues.
Alex: will do. PR will include TF snippet, helm overlay, preflight script, and a smoke test. pinging @Maria for review when ready.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for branch alex/extsecret-rotation passed (build, unit, tfsec) :white_check_mark:
Maria: looking now, leaving inline comments. main ask — please add an acceptance test that recreates a secret with a short TTL to validate rotation path.
Alex: Got it. I'll add a test that uses a short `refreshInterval` in a temp namespace and validates consumer stability. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
Linh: sounds good — if you want me to schedule a small canary in prod next week I can coordinate with infra windows.
Alex: appreciate it — will follow up in PR and schedule canary if tests pass.
Maria: LGTM once tests are added. :shipit:
Sam: +1
